unit: physical/source episode; multiple frames in one episode are not independent cases
selection_rule: Retain all three pre-output cases with a verified instruction-to-video mapping: one author-native task-required reversal, the two existing direct-upstream ViFailback loss/retention development cases. Do not select or remove by future model prediction.

cases.clock: 30 FPS encoded video, frame index / 30 seconds; no robot hardware clock claim
cases.native_label: Six-subtask monotone progress p(f)=(k+(f-s_k)/(e_k-1-s_k))/6; not a current-validity label
cases.semantic_observation: At frame 160 the left red block is on the green mat; by frame 330 it has returned to its blue mat. The instruction explicitly requires this reversal, so leaving the green mat is not regression of the full task.
cases.reference_status: instruction and boundaries by authors; four frames inspected by one reviewer; no model prediction
cases.native_test: RoboMeter/ProgressCompass whole-task progress only, if exact original inference becomes available
cases.added_capability_test: Any current-condition question about red_on_green is a new output requirement, not native progress accuracy

cases.source: ViFailback-Dataset and RoboPulse++ published view1 mapping
cases.clock: encoded video frame / 25 seconds; physical acquisition clock unverified
cases.target_condition: green cube released on and supported by blue cube, required for final three-layer stack
cases.native_label: RoboPulse++ overall falling interval 22-28; ViFailback task-planning failure at subtask 5. Neither is a per-condition monitor-error label.
cases.reference_status: 59-frame source mapping verified across ep621 and ep618; relation/loss/visibility are single-reviewer development judgments; no specialist output

cases.source: ViFailback-Dataset and RoboPulse++ published view1 mapping
cases.clock: encoded video frame / 25 seconds; physical acquisition clock unverified
cases.target_condition: green cube released on and supported by blue cube, required for final three-layer stack
cases.native_label: RoboPulse++ overall falling interval 18-29; ViFailback gripper-6d-pose failure at subtask 5. Neither implies old green-on-blue relation failed.
cases.reference_status: source mapping verified; retained relation is a single-reviewer development judgment; no specialist output

adjudication_gate: No denominator-based condition-error rate or H1 comparison until independent reference and prefix-only visibility review. If the available single-view prefix is ambiguous, record unknown rather than infer from full video.
output_rule: Save unmodified native curves, success values, reasoning text, timestamps, and failures. Do not threshold a task-level progress scalar into green_on_blue without a frozen, independently justified mapping. A method that does not output a per-condition judgment is unevaluable on that new output target, not an incorrect prediction.
